scope: Brief cross-document review of the new audit package only; no expanded repository scan, no credential liveness test, no engineering or scientific rerun. Engineering subsection was authored by this reviewer, so this is cross-document review rather than a new independent engineering recertification.

checks.subject: R6H scope
checks.finding: README agrees with engineering audit: 15 groups / 1153 leaves / 1602 solids, bounded incremental geometry and separate cold group verification; no whole-design, power or flight completion claim.

checks.subject: Electrical and R7
checks.finding: R5E candidate selection distinguished from functional ECO / PCB implementation; AUX / STOP remain uninstalled; next-stage work is advice, not a completed authorization.

checks.subject: Mass configurations
checks.finding: Old Unified R2 31.022864807 kg, WP03 allocated subtotal 20.705235166 kg with 283 unknown instances, and R6H unclosed whole mass remain distinct.

checks.subject: Thermal and propulsion
checks.finding: Old B2 temperature uncertainty and omitted 33.27 W, current MAIN/Q201 thermal gap, unknown actuator geometry / COM and no flight qualification are carried into README.

checks.subject: Research parent/child authority
checks.finding: README preserves parent HOLD versus bounded child PASS, local sim12 reissue scope and the lack of current-R6H task-chain validation. No union-of-PASS promotion identified.

checks.subject: Hash drift
checks.finding: WP10 working_revision mismatch and two sim10 input-pin mismatches are disclosed without rewriting historical evidence.

checks.subject: Inventory numbers
checks.finding: README headline sizes, 2073 initial untracked count, 5090 absolute-path matches, 8111 LFS paths / 41 attribute mismatches and 922.933 MiB installer agree with packaging audit; snapshot and lower-bound limitations are present.

checks.subject: Credential statements
checks.finding: Two AUTH/API assignment occurrences are supported by redacted current, HEAD and one reachable-path-history-version metadata. Provider identity and validity are not claimed; values are not disclosed. No full-history or binary coverage is claimed.

checks.subject: Privacy coverage
checks.finding: Text prescan exclusions, 2 MiB skips, access errors and targeted-only historical follow-up are explicit; the audit is not described as security certification or sanitized public content.

checks.subject: Rights and publication authority
checks.finding: Mixed license and unknown redistribution scope are distinguished; no blanket MIT permission, published package, push, history rewrite or local deletion is claimed.

checks.subject: Portability
checks.finding: 790 native dependencies and portable_package=false remain explicit; public-relative links, isolated package verification and no-commercial-CAD smoke tier are next actions, not achieved results.

nonblocking_observations.finding: E23 HF-ROM difference is labeled relative, while the adjacent cross-solver numeric value lacks an explicit dimensionless-versus-percent label. No numeric contradiction established in this limited cross-review.
nonblocking_observations.suggestion: Before reusing these numbers in a public abstract or figure, show the original machine field name / unit or explicitly convert both to the same notation. This is an optional clarity improvement, not a blocker for delivering the local audit.
